S1.why: A bare count plus adjective is how an Indonesian label marks slots; no noun needed under the tiles.

S2.why: An imperative invitation in the plain verb the app already uses for saving; reads as carrying on, not as a limit.

S3.s: Jatah %lld cutling gratis Anda sudah terpakai. Semuanya tetap gratis dan bisa terus dipakai.
S3.back: Allowance 5 cutling free your already used. All-of-them stay free and can keep being-used.
S3.why: 'Jatah' is the everyday word for a free allowance, so 'sudah terpakai' alone means all used; 'cutling' is the vocab item word, unpluralised after a number.

S4.why: States the offer as a fact instead of 'Anda bisa…', and avoids repeating the title's 'Simpan'.

S5.why: 'X dari Y' is the native count pair; the number order matches, so plain %lld is enough.

S6.why: Shortest native way to say the room on offer within 24 characters; 'Ruang untuk' ran one over.

S7.s: Simpan sampai %@ cutling teks dan %lld cutling gambar.
S7.back: Save until 5.000 cutling text and 500 cutling image.
S7.why: Uses the vocab's own 'cutling teks' and 'cutling gambar'; 'sampai' varies from the bold line's 'hingga' the way a speaker would.

S8.why: PUEBI lists three items with a comma before 'dan'.

S9.s: Satu pembelian berlaku di ketiganya, dengan Apple Account Anda.
S9.back: One purchase applies on the-three-of-them, with Apple Account your.
S9.why: 'Berlaku' is how Indonesians say a purchase or ticket is valid somewhere; 'ketiganya' points back to the bold line; 'Apple Account' kept as the vocab writes it.

S10.why: The phrase people say for a one-off payment; 'saja' makes it warm and final without selling.

S11.s: Tanpa langganan, tanpa iklan, tanpa daftar akun.
S11.back: Without subscription, without ads, without register account.
S11.why: Repeating 'tanpa' is the native rhythm for a list of absences; 'daftar akun' is the verb people use, not the noun 'pendaftaran'.

S12.why: The exact wording Indonesian iOS apps and StoreKit use for this App Store action, in its usual title case.

S13.why: The active verb form of S12, with the ellipsis character.

S14.why: 'Buka versi lengkap' is the Indonesian app phrase for unlocking; bare 'Buka Cutling' would read as 'open Cutling'. 'Seharga' would run one past 26, and 'Bayar sekali saja' sits directly above.

S15.why: Same action as S14 without the price. It runs 18 characters, over the 14 budget, because shortening it brings back the 'open the app' reading; the button has room for S14's 26 plus the price.

S16.why: What an Indonesian says to put something off politely: 'maybe later', not 'no'.

S17.why: iOS Indonesian's label for close buttons.

S18.why: Warm and a little proud in four words, using the vocab's 'Anda'; within 20 characters.

S19.s: Terima kasih sudah membeli. Anda mendukung Cutling dan satu orang di baliknya.
S19.back: Thank you already buying. You support Cutling and one person behind-it.
S19.why: 'Satu orang di baliknya' is the idiom for the one person behind something; it states a fact without pleading.

S20.s: Selamat datang kembali. Pembelian Anda sudah dipulihkan.
S20.back: Welcome back. Purchase your already restored.
S20.why: The standard returning greeting, then 'dipulihkan' to echo S12 so the restore reads as done.

S21.why: Same wording as S5 so VoiceOver and screen agree; no closing period in a spoken label.

S22.s: %lld cutling tersimpan. Kini ada ruang untuk %@.
S22.back: 5 cutling saved. Now there-is room for 5.000.
S22.why: Indonesian has no plural after a number, so the same form works for 1, 2, 5 and 21.

S23.s: Versi lengkap sudah aktif, dengan ruang untuk %@ cutling.
S23.back: Version complete already active, with room for 5.000 cutling.
S23.why: 'Aktif' is the natural state word for something unlocked, paired with S14's 'versi lengkap' so the thing has one name.

S24.why: 'Belum' says it did not complete without blaming anyone and leaves room to try again.

S25.s: App Store sedang tidak bisa dihubungi. Silakan coba beberapa saat lagi.
S25.back: App Store currently cannot be-contacted. Please try a-few moments more.
S25.why: 'Sedang' marks it as temporary; 'beberapa saat lagi' is the usual 'shortly'; 'Silakan' fits the Anda register.

S26.s: App Store tidak mengonfirmasi pembelian ini.
S26.back: App Store did-not confirm purchase this.
S26.why: Plain factual sentence with the App Store as the subject, active verb, KBBI spelling 'mengonfirmasi'.

S27.s: Belum ada pembelian Cutling dengan Apple Account di perangkat ini.
S27.back: Not-yet there-is purchase Cutling with Apple Account on device this.
S27.why: 'Belum ada' is the calm native 'there is none'; 'perangkat' matches the vocab's word for device.

S28.s: Versi gratis menyimpan %lld cutling. Sekali bayar untuk versi lengkap, lalu simpan sesuka Anda.
S28.back: Version free saves 5 cutling. Once pay for version complete, then save as-you-like you.
S28.why: Two short spoken sentences pairing 'versi gratis' with 'versi lengkap'; 'sekali bayar' carries the one-time unlock and 'sesuka Anda' keeps it within 100 characters.

S29.why: The compact count pair under the 'Cutling' title, so the item word is not repeated; within 18 characters.

K1.why: 'Penuh' is the word Indonesians use for full storage and fits the 38-character capsule; tapping really opens the app, so 'Buka Cutling' is literal, and 'Ketuk untuk…' would not fit.

M1.why: A verb-led title in the title case of Indonesian macOS window and menu names, the same phrase as the iPhone button.

M2.why: M1's command as a Mac button, with the ellipsis character because it opens a window.

M3.why: The vocab's item word plus 'gratis' as a row label; the value carries the count.

M4.why: 'X dari Y' is the native compact pair and stays within 10 characters.

M5.why: The status in the same words as S23, so the bought state has one name.

M6.s: Satu pembelian membuka versi lengkap di iPhone, iPad, dan Mac.
M6.back: One purchase unlocks version complete on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
M6.why: 'Membuka versi lengkap' is the unlock phrase with its object, so it never reads as 'opens'; the list follows S8.

M7.s: Versi lengkap aktif di iPhone, iPad, dan Mac dengan Apple Account ini.
M7.back: Version complete active on iPhone, iPad, and Mac with Apple Account this.
M7.why: Repeats M5's status word and S8's list; 'Apple Account' as the vocab writes it.

M8.s: Anda membeli Cutling sebelum digratiskan, jadi versi lengkap tetap milik Anda. Terima kasih.
M8.back: You bought Cutling before made-free, so version complete stays belonging-to you. Thank you.
M8.why: 'Digratiskan' is the everyday word for something being made free; 'tetap milik Anda' echoes S18 and the thanks comes last, plainly.
